title: Hourly Auto-Dig: Energia Global International registration geography and news scan
summary: Dataset-first Offshore Leaks pass adds a source-bounded historical Bermuda registration-jurisdiction edge for Energia Global International, preserves the absence of a defensible street HQ, records a no-material-update current-news search, and queues exact former-office resolution.

data.research_question: What defensible public organizational geography can be added for the selected Offshore Leaks entity without conflating incorporation, registered office, headquarters, or project locations, and is there any material current update to ingest?
data.method: Refreshed current main, recent merged hourly runs, open PRs/issues, operating documentation, topic/import rules, executable v0.9.0 schema, and current workflow contract through the GitHub connector. Used the complete 54-entry dataset/topic universe from current-main hourly selection metadata and the 36 normalized investigation-target records on main. Applied hard previous-three diversity exclusions and current direct-conflict exclusions before deterministic resampling with the recorded seed. The selected topic was topic:offshore-leaks; its current bootstrap exposes one organization candidate requiring location enrichment, Energia Global International, Ltd. Reviewed the existing corpus packet through the repository search surface, then collected ICIJ and IFC evidence. Modeled Bermuda only as a historical registration jurisdiction, with 1997 incorporation and 2012 closure as relation bounds. After completing the location slice, searched current news/web results for material entity/topic changes and created no filler event because none was found.
classification_rules: Dataset stage samples datasets/topics rather than rows so large corpora do not receive more probability from record count.
Previous-three successful hourly datasets are hard-excluded when the pool has at least four candidates.
Datasets/topics with active direct-record conflicts are excluded when non-conflicting alternatives exist.
Registration jurisdiction, registered office, headquarters, principal office, project site, and operating office are distinct location semantics.
No street address or coordinates are created without source-backed precision.
ICIJ inclusion is evidence of a database record, not evidence of illegality or improper conduct.
Current news is ingested only when it adds a material event, correction, supported relation, or organizational/location change.

findings.selection_algorithm: Enumerate the complete 54-entry dataset/topic universe; sort lexicographically; hard-exclude the previous three successful hourly datasets; inspect current open PRs and remove datasets/topics with direct record/surface conflicts; sample the unchanged 64-bit run seed modulo the remaining 34 dataset/topic candidates; then sample the target-stage seed within the selected topic's existing organization candidates requiring public-location enrichment.
findings.initial_draw_conflict: open PR #2065 edits the Milken Institute hourly location/news surface

findings.result: ICIJ records Energia Global International, Ltd. as registered in Bermuda, incorporated 23 October 1997 and closed 7 November 2012. IFC independently described EGI as incorporated in Bermuda. The reviewed sources do not establish a street registered office or headquarters, so the pass models only the historical registration jurisdiction and adds no coordinates.

Searched current web/news surfaces on 19 August 2026 for Energia Global International, the Paradise Papers/Offshore Leaks topic, Bermuda registration, ownership, closure, and location changes. Results were historical ICIJ/IFC material or generic Offshore Leaks database pages; no material new event, correction, ownership update, or location change specific to the selected entity warranted ingestion.
